Definition: of Latin origin; a Roman freedman:--Libertine.
BiblicalUsage: Libertînos means a Roman freedman, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Acts 6:9, "which is called [the synagogue] of the Libertines".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Libertines show how freedom can turn to bondage — freedmen arguing against Stephen, and losing the argument to the Spirit.
